links.surface: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَصَمِّ

notes: «عَنْ أَبِيهِ» is bare: a relation, not identified
the Imam after «عن» inside the chain is a narrator; the question and answer that follow are the saying
«فِي حَدِيثٍ طَوِيلٍ» says the report is abridged here: only the opening of a long narrative is given
